name: Moar
locations: Banani 11, Dhanmondi 27, and Gulshan-Tejgaon Link Road.
priceRange: Starter membership BDT 5,000; Infinity all-location membership BDT 15,000; hour pass BDT 250; day pass BDT 1,000. Meeting rooms start at BDT 250–1,000 depending on capacity.
hours: 8:00–22:00, six days a week; closed Fridays and government holidays.
applicationPath: Book a pass or meeting room online, or enquire about offices and memberships.
notes: A three-location coworking network offering hourly and daily access, memberships, meeting rooms, dedicated or private offices and event space. All-location membership suits people who need to move between Banani, Dhanmondi and the Gulshan–Tejgaon Link Road.

name: Impact Hub Dhaka
locations: Mirpur (9th Floor, Grameen Telecom Bhaban, Zoo Road) and Banani.
priceRange: Coworking membership price not publicly stated. Private offices for one to six people are listed at BDT 52,000–115,000 per month, VAT included.
applicationPath: Book a free tour or submit the Become an Impact Maker form for coworking or office membership.
notes: A coworking and innovation hub for entrepreneurs, freelancers, professionals and impact-focused teams. Alongside desks and private offices, members can access community events, entrepreneurship programmes, consultancy and connections across the wider Impact Hub network.

name: hubdhaka
priceRange: Premium coworking BDT 9,000 per month; Basic Coworking is currently waitlisted; team rooms are quoted on enquiry.
facilities: Event space for up to 130 people
applicationPath: Submit the membership application for evaluation, then schedule a visit and one-day trial if invited.
notes: A community-oriented Mirpur coworking space for freelancers, entrepreneurs and small teams. Membership includes workspace, backup internet and power, printing, lockers and event facilities without a long-term agreement; admission is application-based.
